text:
For those planning to use the service, please allow plenty of time.
I arrived at the clinic at approximately 9:35 AM for my 10 AM appointment. Upon entering, I was met by a staff member or nurse in a pink uniform with short hair who looked confused and asked what I was there for, and if I hadn't made an appointment. I replied that my appointment was at 10 AM. The staff member responded, "10 AM? The doctor arrives at 11 AM." (I felt this was inappropriate language for customer service.) She then added that she had called but I hadn't answered, which was true, but only once. I said I was okay with waiting at the clinic, but she suggested we wait at a cafe, saying it hadn't been cleaned yet. The clinic opens at 9:00 AM, but it hadn't been cleaned, and I couldn't wait there. I had to go to a coffee shop, wasting both time and money. After waiting at the coffee shop for a while, they called to reschedule my appointment to 11:30 AM. This would be a huge waste of time for anyone who has other commitments.

The staff member spoke disrespectfully to the doctor.

-This time, the staff member spoke abruptly, was unwelcoming, and seemed unwilling to serve.

Since there are many other options available, I won't be using their services again.
I will warn my relatives, friends, and family not to use their services. I don't want them to have a bad experience or encounter toxic people.
I'm wary.

text:
This was a terrible experience. The doctor didn't provide any information, didn't ask any questions, and didn't even let me look in the mirror. He just said it wasn't actually his turn, but he saw I'd been waiting a long time. I arrived on time for my appointment to get a front tooth filled because of a dark stain. After the filling was done, he didn't explain anything further. When I went to pay, I had to stand in front of the mirror at the counter and ask the staff which tooth was filled and if the dark stain was still there, or if it was a problem. I received an unclear answer, only being told that there were still several teeth that needed filling.

I've been to other places that were much clearer, but since this one is close to home, I won't be coming back. I had a very bad experience.
